_readme: T2 SLOs and load profile, declared before the JMeter plan was written. Every number is invented (there is no production data yet) and each has its defence in docs/T2-performance.md §2. tools/perf/check-slo.ts evaluates a JMeter run against these and fails the build on a breach. Changing an SLO needs QA-owner review (CODEOWNERS) and is blocked for bots (heal-guard).

correctness.CHECK idempotency (same-key storm): must pass: at most one transaction per idempotency key under concurrency (distinct transaction_ids, and rows per key when the read path exists)
